bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to legacy; appropriating money for ComMUSICation.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; COMMUSICATION.

$250,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Board of Directors of the Minnesota Humanities Center for a grant to ComMUSICation, a nonprofit organization, to amplify young voices and cultivate skills for success through equitable access to music, collaboration, and opportunity.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: $250,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Board of Directors of the Minnesota Humanities Center for a grant to ComMUSICation, a nonprofit organization, to amplify young voices and cultivate skills for success through equitable access to music, collaboration, and opportunity.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
